title: There are new caps for uni places in 2027. What does this mean for domestic students?
paragraphs: For senior school students, anxiety about exams and university offers is a common part of the Year 12 experience.

But new university enrolment caps for domestic students may also be adding to the stress. Several Sydney universities have cut back their new student intakes as a result of federal government limits on student numbers.
But students can feel a bit more reassured by the latest information on caps, released on Thursday.
